answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A river of per-task receipts records who did what, and the harbor of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
